# lakekeeper_tag_definitions (Data Source)

The `lakekeeper_tag_definitions` data source lists all governance tag definitions in a project, sorted by name.

~> **Preview:** Governance tags are a **preview** feature in Lakekeeper and may change in future releases.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/tag/operation/list_tag_definitions)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lakekeeper_tag_definitions" "all" {
  project_id = "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to list tag definitions for.

### Read-Only

- `definitions` (Attributes List) Tag definitions in the project, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definitions))

<a id="nestedatt--definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definitions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag definition was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the tag definition.
- `id` (String) Internal ID in the form `{{project_id}}/{{tag_definition_id}}`.
- `name` (String) The name of the tag definition.
- `scope` (Set of String) Target types this tag definition may be applied to.
- `tag_definition_id` (String) The UUID of the tag definition.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag definition was last updated.
- `value_kind` (String) How values are constrained (`marker`, `free-text`, `enumerated`).
